# Draft:Travis King (investor)

----
Travis King
[https://www.linkedin.com/in/traviskking/ Travis King] is an American investor and entrepreneur. He is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of [https://www.realmlp.com/ REALM], an exclusive investment collective of over 100 prominent family offices. Prior to founding REALM, King co-founded and led [https://www.brixtoncapital.com/ Brixton Capital], a private real estate investment firm. Over a career spanning more than 25 years, he has accumulated over $4 billion in transactional experience across multiple commercial real estate asset classes.
Early Life & Education
Travis King earned his undergraduate degree from the University of California, San Diego, where he graduated magna cum laude, was inducted into Phi Beta Kappa, and received highest distinction honors. He later earned a Master of Business Administration from Harvard Business School.  King is a devout Catholic, after converting to Catholicism in 2008. He has been married to his wife Jennifer, with whom he has eight children, for nearly 30 years.
Career
Brixton Capital
King co-founded Brixton Capital in 2011 and served as its Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer for nearly a decade. Under his leadership, the firm acquired, built, and managed a diversified portfolio of commercial real estate assets across the United States. Brixton's portfolio today exceeds $2.1 billion in value. King remains one of the largest LPs.
REALM
In 2019, King founded REALM, where he currently serves as Founder and Chief Executive Officer. In this role, he oversees all aspects of the organization, including investment strategy, capital deployment, and company culture. REALM is an exclusive investment collective of over 100 prominent family offices with more than $12 billion of aggregated investible assets.
REALM is dedicated to guiding exceptional families in building legacies through real estate ownership. REALM is unique in its ability to leverage its members’ relationships, experience, and capital to source and execute proprietary investments across markets, asset types, and family organizational structures. With over $6 billion in collective transaction experience, REALM has a proven track record of successful real estate investing spanning multiple investment cycles.
Leadership & Business Philosophy
King is known for bringing an entrepreneurial and relational approach to institutional investing, emphasizing creative structuring and win-win outcomes. He is a strong proponent of the conservative use of leverage and fostering alignment among partners. His leadership philosophy emphasizes autonomy, with a strong focus on team-wide discipline and respect.
Public Commentary & Media
King is a recognized thought leader on family office real estate and regularly contributes to public discourse on commercial real estate markets, family office investments, and capital allocation trends. He has been featured across a range of prominent business and real estate media outlets where he provides industry insight on market cycles, asset repricing, capital flows, and the evolving role of private capital in U.S. real estate.
